answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents at random; each must answer a proof-of-work pulse, like a vine living only while it grows along its thread. An attacker with 100 clones must keep 100 heartbeats alive at 100 units of compute per epoch, while an honest agent pays one. A clone that misses its pulse falls into the canyon and forfeits a 20 POA bond, so 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA.
